titles.en: Stone Drum Inscriptions, Palace Museum Ming rubbing album

dimensions.raw: 每半开纵 28.4 厘米，横 15.5 厘米
dimensions.note: Measurements refer to a half-opening of the album.

relationships.note: The museum identifies this as a rubbing of the Stone Drum Inscriptions, not a complete copy of all ten drums.

currentCollection.note: Catalogue holding; no current exhibition claim.
currentCollection.noteZh: 按机构著录记录收藏，不据此判断当前是否展出。

review.note: Draft. The museum dates this rubbing to the early Ming; no individual year is given.
review.noteZh: 草稿。馆方定为明初拓，无确切年份。

notes: The museum notes that the eighth drum is absent from this album.
notesZh: 馆方说明此册缺第八鼓。
